title: Swing twice as far
hook: Change amplitude and predict total mechanical energy.
misconception: total mechanical energy doubles when amplitude doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply E = ½kA² to compare total mechanical energy when amplitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal spring oscillator with fixed stiffness, E = ½kA². When amplitude doubles, total mechanical energy becomes 4 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model E = ½kA²; scaling exponent 2. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal spring oscillator with fixed stiffness, with a nonzero initial result. If amplitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on total mechanical energy?
recall.why: Apply E = ½kA² under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 9.
